## Compilation (local)

```bash
cd overleaf/
pdflatex main.tex
bibtex main
pdflatex main.tex
pdflatex main.tex
```

## Upload to Overleaf

1. Zip this entire `overleaf/` folder
2. Create new Overleaf project → Upload Project → select the zip
3. Download `icml2025.sty` from https://icml.cc/Conferences/2025/StyleAuthorInstructions and add to root
4. Set compiler to **pdfLaTeX**
5. Compile

## Notes

- `icml2025.sty` is **not included** — download from ICML 2025 website
- All figures are PNG format; adjust `\includegraphics` width as needed for two-column layout
- Citations use `natbib` with `icml2025` bibliography style
- Anonymous submission: author/affiliation fields contain placeholder text
